comparison.objective: Meter a hydraulic valve to lower a fragile cabinet gently; candidate removes and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous valve modulation based on load motion and controlled landing versus small-feature tool alignment, separate-hammer striking, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Landing at safe speed, no glass contact, load transferred to rails, and three-second hands-off support versus four safe fractures and two-second stable containment.
comparison.reason: Both regulate force-related consequences, but hydraulic descent control is a different central mechanism and outcome from localized impact fracture.
